paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it pairs forecasting and budgeting with improving the reporting behind them, and lending software is a business I'd like to understand from the inside.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting through reconciliation work.

That maps to the variance commentary, forecasts and KPI reporting the role describes. I'm comfortable in Excel, SAP and Tableau and used to building reports that leadership actually reads. I'd welcome the chance to talk with the team.
